author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Using AI feels like go back to pre-WYSIWYG era.

In Word Perfect the DOS version, when I type document with formatting, I sort of have to visualize how the document looks like as I type, then preview to check it is what I expected before print.

Vibe coding or ask AI agent to complete a task for you has the same feeling.
